parsed.explanation: Step 3 correctly states the move's effect on valuations, (α,β)↦(min(α,β),|α−β|), and correctly formulates the needed biconditional on common divisors t, but then writes '(standard; details omitted)'. No proof of gcd(α,β)=gcd(min(α,β),|α−β|) (via gcd(x,y)=gcd(x,y−x)) appears, and the equal-valuation case (α=β, giving (α,0)) and zero-valuation cases are not addressed. The only other mention, in 'Current best' ('which preserves gcd's'), is likewise a bare assertion, as is the computer check ('2000 single-move invariant checks'), which is numerical and not credited. Hence the invariance mechanism is named but not argued. A one-sentence insertion of gcd(x,y)=gcd(x,|y−x|) with min/max case analysis repairs it.
